in_sanskrit.name: तriptि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who fulfills all desires or needs, the one who is satisfied with all, the one who experiences the fullness of life.

in_hindi.name: तriptि
in_hindi.long_meaning: व्यक्ति जिसके लिए सभी कामनाएं पूरी होती हैं, जो सब की आर्थिक और आत्मविशेष अनुकूलियों को पूरा करता है, जो जीवन के पूर्णता के साथ है.

in_telugu.name: తృృృృృృృ
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఒయ్యే దేశాదేశినీ, ఒయ్యే పూర్ణమీదేశినీ, ఒయ్యే జీవనేదేశినీ.

vedic_reference.note: Tripti is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'tri' meaning 'three' and the suffix 'pti' meaning 'fulfillment'. In Hindu mythology, Tripuri, a mountain range, is also known as Tripti because it is believed to fulfill the desires of those who visit it.
